sops.title: Diamond Reserve: confirm the 4 PM late checkout
sops.kw: diamond reserve, late checkout, 4pm checkout, 4 pm, guaranteed late checkout, departure time, diamond reserve checkout

steps.t: Diamond Reserve members get a guaranteed 4 PM late checkout. PEP adds 4 PM to their reservation automatically.
Don't assume they need 4 PM. At check-in, or the evening before departure, ask the guest what time they actually plan to check out.
In PEP, open the reservation > Stay tab > Departure Time and set the time the guest gave you (4 PM at the latest). Save.
Post it in the housekeeping WhatsApp chat so they can plan the room: room number, guest name and the confirmed checkout time.
steps.hampton: Post it in the Hampton HK WhatsApp chat so housekeeping can plan the room: room number, guest name and the confirmed checkout time.

steps.t: Copy the guest line from the top of the reservation in PEP: confirmation number / LAST, FIRST / Room - number.

Log it in {Log book app} > Add Log Book. Headline: paste the guest line, then add "- Housekeeping- Late Checkout". Entry: "Confirmed with the Diamond Reserve Member that they will be checking out by [time]. Adjusted on PEP and communicated on WhatsApp." Date: today. Property: this hotel. Post.
steps.hampton: Log it in Quore > Add Log Book. Headline: paste the guest line, then add "- Housekeeping- Late Checkout". Entry: "Confirmed with the Diamond Reserve Member that they will be checking out by [time]. Adjusted on PEP and communicated on WhatsApp." Date: today. Property: Hampton Inn Overland Park. Post.

sops.script: "As a Diamond Reserve member, your checkout is guaranteed until 4 PM. What time would you like to check out?"
sops.flag: The guest wants to stay past 4 PM, or the 4 PM checkout is missing from a Diamond Reserve reservation. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Diamond Reserve: other benefits
sops.kw: diamond reserve, diamond reserve benefits, confirmed upgrade, confirmable upgrade reward, cur, top tier, highest tier

steps.t: Diamond Reserve is Hilton Honors' top tier, above Diamond. It includes every Diamond benefit.
Late checkout: guaranteed until 4 PM. Follow HH-11 to confirm the real time.
Upgrades: Diamond Reserve gets the highest upgrade priority. Offer the best room available for the whole stay before any other guest (HH-06).
Confirmed Upgrade Rewards: if the reservation shows a confirmed upgrade, it's already guaranteed. Honor it; don't downgrade the room.
Bonus points (120%) post automatically after the stay. Nothing to do at the desk.
Hilton's Diamond Reserve support team may call the hotel with a request for the guest. Treat it like a request from the guest and log it.

sops.script: "Welcome back, and thank you for being a Diamond Reserve member."
sops.flag: You can't honor a confirmed upgrade or the guest says a benefit is missing. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Honors tier benefits
sops.kw: tier benefits, gold benefits, diamond benefits, silver benefits, diamond reserve benefits, what do i get, honors status

steps.t: Tiers, lowest to highest: Member, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Diamond Reserve. Check the tier on the reservation.
Silver: bonus points; two bottles of water at check-in where offered.
Gold: Silver benefits plus space-available upgrades and more bonus points. [CHECK: Gold food and beverage credit at Hampton]
Diamond: Gold benefits plus more bonus points, premium Wi-Fi and a 48-hour room guarantee (booked through Hilton). Diamond members can check in without a physical ID (property rule).
Diamond Reserve: Diamond benefits plus a guaranteed 4 PM late checkout and the highest upgrade priority. See HH-11 and HH-12.
Late checkout for every other tier follows CO-04: full night after {Late check-out cutoff} unless a manager waives it.
For anything else, the guest can check their benefits in the Hilton Honors app.
